scope: Fixed development-exposed69-target feasibility analysis; not independent experimental or generalization validation. No new molecular predictions, model fitting or selected estimator.
cohort: All69exact-family pairs in the existing corrected OOF comparison, without error-based exclusion.
spread: Population SD of the100archivedauthor-selectedOOFreplicate predictions, divided by absolute signed extent scale. This is a development proxy, not the released pretrained-model uncertainty and not a total-error interval.
primary_risk: OOF comparator mean absolute error among retained targets. MetaG and zero errors reported on exactly the same retained subsets.
ties: Average over every exact-k subset of the boundary score tier; no label-based or ID-based favorable tie breaking.
combined_policy: Equal-weight rank combination fixed before new ranking outcomes. No fitted coefficients or post-outcome score selection.
aggregate: Discrete AURC is the mean of MAE across k=1..N, on identical target counts.
random_selection_context: Exact finite-cohort probability of zero severe comparator errors in a uniformly sampled k-subset, conditional on observed full-cohort severe count. Not a generalization probability or formal model-comparison p-value.
uncertainty: Do not invent reaction-independent confidence intervals. Source/family dependence clusters have not been curated for this aggregate-label cohort; current output is descriptive only. Optional future cluster bootstrap requires explicit clusters, at least10clusters, and independent enrollment validated separately.

bootstrap_if_eligible.interval: percentile95% on paired fixed-score resampled clusters

interpretation: A favorable development result is a hypothesis for a later independently frozen evaluation. Agreement does not imply independent errors or total predictive reliability.
